mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 95.0), a decline in industrial production signals reduced output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL (y/y) > 3.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a severe labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a low-rate easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.
